funds.name: Blue Chip VC specialised technology fund

size.raw: RM120 million initial capital, raising up to US$200 million (RM956 million)

strategy.thesis: Penang-based specialised technology fund backing semiconductor companies in three value-chain segments — advanced packaging, integrated-circuit (IC) design and niche equipment manufacturing — with the goal of helping firms relocate from China, localise and eventually list on Bursa Malaysia.

people.name: Tim Chen Yongzheng
people.role: Chief Executive (previously AT&T Labs, Microsoft, Motorola)

application.how_to_apply: Direct outreach; no public application portal found

summary.en: Penang (George Town) semiconductor-focused VC set up in early 2023 by former Intel executive Datuk Lai Pin Yong and CEO Tim Chen. Started with RM120 million initial capital (fully committed to leading local electronics companies) and is raising a new fund targeting US$200 million to back IC design, advanced packaging and niche equipment firms, aiming for >20% annual returns and Bursa Malaysia listings. Has 12 LPs including founders of three listed Penang E&E companies and a co-founder of a top-10 Chinese semiconductor firm.

summary.en: Technology investment fund launched October 2024 by Vietnam's largest private conglomerate Vingroup (chaired by Pham Nhat Vuong), managing US$150 million in AUM — US$100 million inherited from Vingroup's existing portfolio plus US$50 million to be disbursed over 3-5 years. Focuses on AI, semiconductors and cloud computing at seed and Series A, prioritising Vietnamese founding teams. Portfolio includes VinAI and VinBrain.

name.en: Sunway iLabs Deep Tech Ventures Lab

aka: Sunway Innovation Labs Deep Tech Ventures Lab

strategy.thesis: A six-month co-creation venture-building programme (launched with government agency Cradle) to build and scale IP-driven deep-tech startups across seven verticals including semiconductor applications, intelligent autonomy, AI/deep tech and energy transition, bridging technology and commercialisation in Malaysia.

application.how_to_apply: Apply via Sunway iLabs Deep Tech Ventures Lab page

summary.en: Six-month deep-tech venture-building programme launched July 2025 by Sunway iLabs (the innovation lab / CVC arm of Sunway Group) together with Malaysian government agency Cradle. The 2025 cohort selected 20 startups from 69 applicants (~29% acceptance) across seven verticals including semiconductor applications, AI/deep tech, intelligent autonomy, energy transition and decarbonisation, with a demo day in October/November 2025. Aims to bridge technology and commercialisation for IP-driven Malaysian deep-tech startups.

name.en: Collaborative Research in Engineering, Science & Technology (CREST)

aum.raw: RM205 million total grants approved since 2012

strategy.thesis: Penang-based industry-led R&D funding body for Malaysia's electrical and electronics (E&E) / semiconductor ecosystem, providing matching grants for industry-academia collaborative R&D in IC design, advanced manufacturing, embedded systems, LED, GaN power electronics, EV and SoC/RF technologies.
strategy._check_size_note: Grants matched against industry contribution; per-project size not standardised

program.eligibility: Malaysia-registered company paired with at least one Malaysian university; industry contribution must be at least 50% of project budget

application.how_to_apply: Submit CREST R&D grant application (industry-university pairing required)

summary.en: Penang (Bayan Lepas) industry-led R&D body established in 2011 to grow Malaysia's electrical-and-electronics / semiconductor ecosystem. Provides matching grants for industry-academia collaborative R&D across IC design, advanced manufacturing, embedded systems, LED and GaN power electronics (for EV, SoC and RF). Has approved 161 projects worth RM205 million in grants since 2012, with ~36% funded by CREST and ~64% by industry players; companies must be Malaysia-registered and pair with a Malaysian university.

strategy._check_size_note: Fund size and check size not disclosed

summary.en: A semiconductor-dedicated investment fund formed under an MOU signed on 8 August 2024 between Vietnam's FPT Corporation and Taiwan's financial advisory firm FCC Partners. The fund aims to develop semiconductor talent, attract foreign investment, support startups and promote innovation in Vietnam's chip industry, with proposed lab locations in Hanoi, Da Nang and Ho Chi Minh City. Fund size has not been disclosed.

aum.raw: Initial charter capital VND500 billion (~US$19.1 million); target ≥VND5,000 billion (~US$190.7 million) by 2035

current_fund.raw: VND500 billion charter capital (40% city / 60% private)

strategy.thesis: A public-private joint-stock venture fund established by the Ho Chi Minh City government to invest in high-value technology — including semiconductor and microchip design, AI, big data, blockchain, biotechnology, advanced materials, renewable energy and robotics/automation — targeting 50-150 startups between 2026 and 2035.

application.how_to_apply: Via the fund once incorporated (procedures expected to conclude March 2026)

summary.en: A public-private joint-stock venture fund being established by the Ho Chi Minh City government, with legal procedures expected to conclude in March 2026. Launches with VND500 billion (~US$19.1 million) charter capital (40% city / 60% private investors) and aims to grow to at least VND5,000 billion (~US$190.7 million) by 2035. Priority sectors include semiconductor and microchip design, AI, big data, advanced materials, renewable energy and robotics/automation; targets 50-150 startups over 2026-2035. Vingroup, VinaCapital, VNG and FPT have expressed interest as founding shareholders.
summary.local: Quỹ Đầu tư Mạo hiểm TP.HCM với vốn điều lệ ban đầu 500 tỷ đồng, ưu tiên bán dẫn, thiết kế vi mạch, AI, vật liệu tiên tiến và robot.
